articles.title: Solana’s fee overhaul increases burn and makes resource hogs pay
articles.snippet: Solana’s proposed fee overhaul would make resource-heavy transactions more expensive while cutting costs for simpler activity, and it increases the amount of SOL burned.

articles.title: RedotPay US IPO delayed amid regulatory, legal hurdles: Report
articles.snippet: RedotPay’s US IPO has reportedly been delayed as it seeks regulatory approvals, while the company says it secured a US money transmitter license.

articles.title: White House Lets Private Firms Hack Cybercriminals—At Their Own Legal Risk
articles.snippet: President Donald Trump signed a memorandum Tuesday that lets vetted U.S. companies carry out offensive cyber operations against foreign criminal networks. Here's what the program actually authorizes.

articles.title: FCA, HTX in Settlement Talks Over Illegal UK Crypto Promotions: Report
articles.snippet: An FCA employee bought crypto from a UK IP address using a driving license as ID, according to the regulator's claim.
